title: Notsotiny: A Large, Living Benchmark for RTL Code Generation
extraction_scope: Selected sections 2.4, 3, 4.2; no table transcription or artifact execution
identity: Exact normalized title; seven corresponding authors, with expanded Razine Moundir Ghorab and Cristian Gutierrez-Gomez names versus abbreviated program names. Preprint DOI is a placeholder, not a publication identifier.

conditions.task: Contextual module completion, not unconstrained specification-to-chip design
conditions.selection: Section 2.4: self-equivalence compatibility filtering reduces 3062 deduplicated tasks to 1114.
conditions.verification: Section 4.2: Yosys equiv_simple and equiv_induct; reported k=30. Partition coverage is partial credit, distinct from full equivalence.
conditions.contamination: Section 3: comparative Min-K across 11 models; reference-only inputs, modules over 2000 tokens excluded, no binary contamination threshold.

researcher_qualifications: Compatibility filtering can select for verifier tractability; report excluded-task characteristics before generalizing.
Do not equate the paper's bounded-depth wording with the actual semantics of a successful inductive proof; inspect the exact script and reset assumptions.
A comparative memorization signal is not proof of training-set exclusion.
A changing benchmark requires version-matched comparisons; live scores cannot by themselves establish model progress.
revisit_condition: Pin verifier and dataset release; inspect proof commands, exclusions, timeouts and inference budgets before accepting quantitative synthesis.
